en: The postcard shows a sepia-toned photograph of a grand, ornate building on a square or street, with people strolling in period attire, likely from the early 20th century. The caption in red text reads 'Göteborg. Vasaplatsen.' There is handwritten text in Swedish at the bottom of the image. The reverse side of the postcard has green decorative borders and text printed in Swedish, a Swedish postage stamp, and handwritten address details.
